# LaunchFree.io — The Runway

> LaunchFree.io (brand name: The Runway) is a free, human-reviewed launch directory for founders, indie makers, and side hustlers. Anyone can submit a product, service, business, or idea and receive a permanent listing page with a free dofollow backlink, a "Listed on The Runway" badge, and a feature in the weekly "Runway Radar" newsletter. Listing is free forever. No fees, no approval fee, no paywall. Every submission is reviewed by a real person within about 24 hours.

Operated by Automated Income Tools LLC. Founder: Julie James. Contact: hello@launchfree.io. There are currently 4632 live launches spanning categories including AI / ML, Developer Tools, SaaS, Creator Tools, Productivity, Fintech, Education, Other, Health, Service, Marketing, Travel, Community, E-commerce, Affiliate, Entertainment, Lifestyle.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://launchfree.io/): What The Runway is and why it exists: a free, human-reviewed launch directory. Every launch needs a runway; yours is free.
- [Browse the Runway](https://launchfree.io/browse.html): The full, filterable grid of every live launch, searchable by category, stage, and popularity.
- [Directory (all launches, static HTML)](https://launchfree.io/directory.html): Every launch as plain links grouped by category. The full catalog, crawlable without JavaScript.
- [Submit your launch](https://launchfree.io/submit.html): Free submission form. After a ~24-hour human review you get a permanent listing page, a free dofollow backlink, a badge, and a newsletter feature.
- [Advertise](https://launchfree.io/advertise.html): Sponsor LaunchFree.io. Homepage feature (one sponsor at a time, booked by the week or month), Runway Radar newsletter sponsor spot, and custom partnerships. Pricing by custom proposal. Paid placements are always labeled Sponsored and never affect approval, ranking, or votes.
- [Runway Radar](https://launchfree.io/radar.html): The content hub of free-launch guides: where to launch for free, how dofollow backlinks help SEO, and how to get traction with no audience or budget.
- [Bootstrap Founder Tools](https://launchfree.io/bootstrap-founder-tools.html): Guide and hub for bootstrapped founders looking to launch and get discovered for free.
- [Free Product Launch Directory](https://launchfree.io/free-product-launch-directory.html): Overview of LaunchFree as a genuinely free, no-paywall alternative to paid launch platforms.
- [Indie Maker Directory](https://launchfree.io/indie-maker-directory.html): Directory hub for indie makers and solo builders to list side projects and MVPs for free.
- [Launch Your SaaS Free](https://launchfree.io/launch-saas-free.html): How to launch a SaaS product for free on The Runway and earn a permanent dofollow backlink.
- [Privacy Policy](https://launchfree.io/privacy.html): How LaunchFree.io handles data and privacy.
- [Terms](https://launchfree.io/terms.html): Terms of use for LaunchFree.io.
- [Disclaimer](https://launchfree.io/disclaimer.html): Site disclaimer for LaunchFree.io.
